title: Hockley County Democrats Launch Grassroots Precinct Outreach
author: Aaron Gonzalez, County Chair
excerpt: Democrats across Levelland, Ropesville, Smyer, Sundown, and Anton are gearing up for voter engagement and precinct chair appointments.
content: Welcome to the official digital home of the Hockley County Democratic Party! We are dedicated to organizing our communities, fighting for strong public schools, rural infrastructure, accessible healthcare, and empowering everyday Texans to make their voices heard at the ballot box.\n\nWhether you live in Levelland, Ropesville, Smyer, Sundown, Anton, or anywhere in between, there is a place for you in our movement. Check out our upcoming meetings and join us!
